quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: When you see a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon with two flashing red lights, you must:

options.text: Proceed with caution.
Stop completely, then proceed with caution.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon helps pedestrians cross safely. It only works when a pedestrian activates it. Two flashing red lights mean you must stop completely before you proceed with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slippery when wet.
Watch for drunk drivers.
Dangerous curve ahead.
Bump in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because the pavement can be slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill by a curb, set your parking brake and turn your wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will roll toward the curb and stop.

questions.question: Roads become very slippery:

options.text: When it has been raining for an hour or more.
The day after it rains.
For the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
Right after the rain has stopped.

questions.correctAnswerText: For the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. Rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. This is worse in hot weather because heat makes more oil rise to the road.

questions.question: You may cross double solid yellow lines:

options.text: To pass a slow-moving truck.
To turn into a driveway.
To pass another car.
Under no conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into a driveway, to exit a highway, or to make a U-turn where allowed.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means:

options.text: Stop and look for other vehicles, then go if there is no traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get into a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt
The steering wheel
Your rearview mirror
Your seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: First, adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. After your seat is set, adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: The most important thing about speed and curves is that you must:

options.text: Drive at the posted speed limit as you enter the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the posted speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Your car's momentum can make it hard to turn in curves. To stay in control, you must slow down before entering the curve.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of these, except:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much alcohol you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your body weight. Your physical fitness level does not affect BAC.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing it. You may:

options.text: Cross these lines only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross these lines to pass other vehicles, but only if there is no oncoming traffic.
Cross these lines under no circumstances.
Cross these lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross these lines only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean passing is not allowed from either direction. You can only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.

options.text: Stop
Wrong way
Yield
Do not enter

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, turn your steering wheel:

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. It doesn't matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the wheel in the direction you want the car to go. Once the car straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you can check your blind spots by:

options.text: Using the inside rearview mirror.
Using the outside rearview mirror.
Using both inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: You come to an intersection that is blocked by other traffic. You should:

options.text: Go slowly until the traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front of you.
Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through.
Sound your horn to make the cars move up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if traffic is backed up on the other side. Wait until you can drive completely through the intersection without stopping in it.

questions.question: Allow a larger space cushion than usual when stopping:

options.text: On an incline.
At an intersection.
At a stop sign.
At a toll plaza.

questions.correctAnswerText: On an incline.
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your car when stopped on a hill. The car in front may roll backward when traffic starts moving again.

questions.question: When a vehicle with an Anti-Lock Braking System starts to lose traction on a slippery road, drivers should:

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal.
Press and hold the gas pedal.
Lightly tap the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: Press hard on the brake pedal and hold it. Steer away from danger. The ABS system automatically pumps the brakes faster than you can. Do not pump the brakes yourself or release the pedal, or the ABS will not work.

questions.question: It is illegal for a person 21 years of age or older to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:

options.text: 0.05 percent.
0.08 percent.
0.02 percent.
0.1 percent.

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent.
questions.explanation: For drivers 21 and older, it is illegal to drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: You are approaching an intersection when the traffic light changes from green to solid yellow. You should:

options.text: Consider it the same as a caution sign and continue through the intersection.
Stop immediately.
Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
Speed up to get through the intersection before the red light appears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a yellow light, try to stop before entering the intersection. If you cannot stop safely, drive carefully through.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should generally:

options.text: Enter above the speed of traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Accelerate to the speed of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Accelerate to the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane to speed up to match the highway traffic. Signal, look for an opening, then merge safely.

questions.question: When exiting a highway, you should slow down:

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
Once you have moved into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Once you have moved into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane early. Slow down after you enter the exit lane, not before.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: Upcoming intersections.
Road construction.
A curve in the road ahead.
Changes in traffic lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks next to each other, what should you do?

options.text: It is always safe to proceed after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check the other track for another train before proceeding.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check the other track for another train before proceeding.
questions.explanation: With two railroad tracks, a second train can come on the other track. Always check both tracks before crossing. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming from either direction on either track.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, look over your shoulder toward the direction you are moving to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection with a green light, but traffic is coming. What should you do?

options.text: Use the next intersection.
Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Move into the center of the intersection and wait for traffic to clear.
Turn because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move into the center of the intersection and wait for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with oncoming traffic, you can enter the intersection if the light is green. Wait in the center for oncoming traffic to pass before completing your turn.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway slants toward the left. What does this mean?

options.text: There is an intersection just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You will be required to turn left just ahead.
The road will get narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will get narrower.
questions.explanation: A solid line on the side of the road shows the road's edge. When this line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower ahead.
